item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 09:20 AM 19 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesNorte(Labo, Vinzons, Paracale), #Catanduanes(SanAndres, SanMiguel, Gigmoto, Baras, Bato, Virac), #CamarinesSur(Pasacao, Pamplona, Gainza, SanFernando, Milaor, Pili, Ocampo, Tigaon, Sagñay, Minalabac, Bula, Baao, IrigaCity, Buhi, Nabua, Balatan), #Albay(Tiwi, RapuRapu, Malinao, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot, Bacacay, SantoDomingo, Manito, LegazpiCity), #Sorsogon(Casiguran, Barcelona, Bulusan, Juban, Magallanes, Irosin, SantaMagdalena, Bulan, Matnog and Castilla) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes, Basud, SanLorenzoRuiz, SanVicente, Talisay, Daet), #CamarinesSur(Sipocot, Lupi, Cabusao, Calabanga, Bombon, Libmanan, Magarao, Canaman, NagaCity, DelGallego, Ragay, Siruma, Tinambac, Lagonoy, Goa, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Presentacion, SanJose, Camaligan), #Catanduanes(Pandan, Caramoran, Bagamanoc, Viga, Panganiban), #Sorsogon(PrietoDiaz, Gubat and CityOfSorsogon) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
